note: Grantable entitlements and their sensitivity. Some entitlements have amount tiers; some require a named approver above a threshold; some are mutually exclusive for a single holder under separation-of-duties.

refund_authority.note: Max single-refund amount the holder may approve. 'elevated' and above require sign-off.

ledger_write.note: Direct write access to the settlement ledger. High-risk; restricted to Finance Ops.

approval_limit_usd.note: Payment-approval limit in USD. Raises above the standard limit require a Finance Director sign-off.

sanctions_override.note: Ability to override a sanctions screening block. Restricted to the Sanctions Desk; never granted to a standard ops role.
